result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue where a restaurant title is prematurely clipped mid-character despite available space.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped mid-character ('Tokumaru Rameı') without an ellipsis, despite plenty of empty horizontal space before the rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Expand the width or flex-grow constraint of the restaurant title container so it uses available space up to the rating element, and apply 'text-overflow: ellipsis' if truncation is ever needed.
